You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:patient_data_exposure: Patient-data access or exposure always goes to a human. Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
Seeing the wrong family's results

When I open this family's account I can see another patient's lab results.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hi,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I understand that when you open a family's account you are seeing lab results that belong to a different patient. This is a serious concern, and a member of our support team is currently reviewing the issue.

We will keep you informed as we investigate.

Best regards,
[Support Team]"
}
